scripts.dev: npm run dev:assets && npm run dev:preload && concurrently -k -n MAIN,VITE -c green,magenta "npm:dev:main" "npm:dev:renderer"
scripts.dev:main: tsc --outDir build_dev/shared --project src/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --outDir build_dev/core --project src/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --outDir build_dev/main --project src/main/tsconfig.json && concurrently "tsc --watch --outDir build_dev --project src/main/tsconfig.json" "tsc-alias -w --outDir build_dev --project src/core/tsconfig.json" "tsc-alias -w --outDir build_dev --project src/main/tsconfig.json"
scripts.dev:assets: copyfiles -u 1 main_assets/* build_dev/main_assets && copyfiles -u 1 main_assets/**/* build_dev/main_assets
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:assets: copyfiles -u 1 main_assets/* build_dist/main_assets && copyfiles -u 1 main_assets/**/* build_dist/main_assets
